notes.title: Notepad
notes.content:
This update brought up an essential feature, the notepad. With this, you can note in-game information, like stock market prices and more.
We added these new features:

- Notepad
- Internal smelting

Bug fixes:
- Crafting, item amount.
- Transport efficiency

If you desire any features you can let us know...

notes.title: Stock market & Cryptocurrencies
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Stock market & Cryptocurrencies[/b][/i][/h3]

Now you can buy shares of companies and cryptocurrencies. Also, some bug fixes around investment, making it more reliable.  We implemented for the start just 5 of each, if you like it or you would like to see something specific let us know through our support email or:
[url=https://www.instagram.com/ethernal_studio/]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/ethernalstudio_]Twitter[/url]

List of features added:

5 cryptocurrencies were added:
-Beta
-Cat coin
-Fractured
-Sigma coin
-Ethernal coin

5 company shares were added:
-Tritum and. shares
-SM Art shares
-Talia's shares
-Spinverse shares
-Ethernal studio shares

Smaller features added:
-Amount of items shown in preview mode
-Management tweaking

Bugg fixes:
-Investment money text does not show anything
-Investment not returning money
